description: Pass extra arguments to the agent harness with `--` (spec: tasks/prd-provider-pass-through-args.md)

userStories.title: Role strings accept `--`
userStories.description: As a user, I want to write extra args in a role string in .redeye.json so that each role's harness gets its own flags.
acceptanceCriteria: ParsedRole in src/config.ts has an optional extraArgs:string[] field
parseRoleString('pi -m sonnet -- --no-skills --foo') returns extraArgs ['--no-skills', '--foo'] and model 'sonnet'
Tokens after `--` are not parsed as redeye options: parseRoleString('pi -- -m other') returns no model and extraArgs ['-m', 'other']
A role string with no `--`, or with `--` followed by nothing, returns no extraArgs (field absent or empty)
A stray positional before `--` still throws the existing 'Extra positional argument' error
The parseRoleString yargs parser uses parserConfiguration({ 'populate--': true }) and reads the extras from parsed['--']
renderRoleString appends ' -- <args>' when extraArgs is non-empty, and parseRoleString(renderRoleString(role)) round-trips
Unit tests in test/config.test.ts cover the cases above
npm run lint passes
Typecheck passes (npm run build, which runs tsc)
Tests pass

userStories.title: The CLI accepts `--`
userStories.description: As a user, I want to write `redeye pi -- --no-context-files` so that the implement role's harness gets those flags for this run.
acceptanceCriteria: The default command in src/index.ts collects everything after `--` into a list without yargs parsing it (parserConfiguration({ 'populate--': true }), read from argv['--'])
Tokens after `--` never trip .strict() and are never read as redeye options or as the provider/turns positionals
CliOptions in src/config.ts has an optional extraArgs:string[], and runExecute passes the collected list through it to resolveRoles (resolveRoles may ignore it until US-003)
An integration test in test/integration.test.ts shows `redeye pi --dry-run -- --no-skills` exits 0, as it does without the `--` part
init and graph are unaffected (their existing tests still pass)
npm run lint passes
Typecheck passes (npm run build, which runs tsc)
Tests pass

userStories.title: resolveRoles merges extra args
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one place that decides each role's extra args so that the rules cannot drift between call sites.
acceptanceCriteria: With a CLI provider, implement.extraArgs is the CLI's extra args only (a CLI provider replaces the implement role whole)
With no CLI provider, implement.extraArgs is the implement role string's extra args followed by the CLI's ([...role, ...cli])
review.extraArgs is always the review role string's extra args only; CLI extra args never reach the review role
implementStr (run header and review logs) includes the merged implement extra args, rendered with renderRoleString
Unit tests in test/config.test.ts cover all three merge rules and the implementStr rendering
npm run lint passes
Typecheck passes (npm run build, which runs tsc)
Tests pass

userStories.title: spawnAgent forwards extra args
userStories.description: As a user, I want the extra args to reach the harness process so that its behavior changes.
acceptanceCriteria: spawnAgent in src/orchestrator.ts takes an optional extraArgs:string[]
Extra args are placed after every flag redeye builds (provider args, --model, --max-turns, --thinking or --effort, codex's -c) and before pi's @<prompt file>, so the prompt stays the last argument
Extra args are passed as separate argv entries, in order, with no shell, quoting or splitting applied
With extraArgs absent or empty, the argv is exactly what it is today for every provider (claude, pi, codex, hermes)
A test using FAKE_CLAUDE_ARGV_LOG asserts the extra args appear as a contiguous run in the spawned argv, after --model
A pi test (new argv-logging key on the fake pi if needed) asserts the last argv entry still starts with '@'
Any new FAKE_* env key is added to the key list of every test file that sets it (FAKE_CLAUDE_KEYS, FAKE_ENV_KEYS, ENV_KEYS)
npm run lint passes
Typecheck passes (npm run build, which runs tsc)
Tests pass

The value comes from the roles resolved by resolveRoles, never from argv directly
With no `--` anywhere, every spawned argv is unchanged (existing tests pass)

userStories.title: End-of-run review pass passes extraArgs

userStories.title: Review-role spawns pass review.extraArgs

The same test shows CLI `--` extra args do not appear on review spawns

userStories.title: Document the `--` syntax
userStories.description: As a user, I want the README and --help to show `--` so that I can find the feature.
acceptanceCriteria: The default command's usage or epilog in --help shows an example with `--`
README documents the CLI form, the role-string form, the merge rules from US-003, and the argv placement from US-004
README warns that redeye does not check forwarded args, and that flags which change the harness's output format (pi's --mode, claude's --output-format) or its permission mode will break the run
README notes that pi's --no-context-files also stops pi from loading the target project's AGENTS.md
README notes that for hermes, extra args land after `chat`, so only chat options work there
The AGENTS.md invariant about provider-specific options gets one line saying extra args are decided in resolveRoles and placed by spawnAgent
Docs use `--` instead of em dashes and `->` instead of arrow characters
No tests are written for docs
npm run lint passes
Typecheck passes (npm run build, which runs tsc)
